title: The dtbau demo aggregates IFC hierarchy, BCF comments, and a PM document model into role-tailored views
content:
Intended outcome (BIM briefing): demonstrate to dtbau that Powerhouse can on-board users and give each an information view **tailored to their role and identity**, aggregating three sources from the existing backup solution:

- **Source 1 — IFC object hierarchy**, extracted per IFC file, exposed to LLMs as a conceptual snapshot ("this file has one building with one floor and two rooms with IDs …")
- **Source 2 — BCF comments** carrying IFC object references, joined to Source 1 objects (by GlobalId)
- **Source 3 — a PM-level document model** that references and depends on Sources 1 and 2; inspiration: Plannerly's document types (EIR, BEP)

Demo scenario (WIP): a dtbau admin invites the MEPF-responsible manager; on accepting, the manager sees **only** the BCF comments on relevant IFC classes (ducts, pipes, cables) plus related IFC files. User types get their own drive scoped to the documents they should access (PFNÜR project structure).

Cross-silo AI work to illustrate: flagging MEPF IFC files with mismatching objects; auto-tagging non-BCF comments related to MEPF work; progress auto-updating in the MEPF section of the PM document.
description: Demo intent: onboard users by role/identity, combining 3 sources — LLM-readable IFC object hierarchy, BCF comments joined by GlobalId, and a PM document that references both.
